thread:
ana_marketing: Quick preflight for Friday's announcement (publish 10:00 PT). Need: final headline (1 line), single benchmark stat for hero, canonical docs link, rollout timing, legal yay/nay on copy, and sales routing tag. Tagging eng/docs/legal/sales.

raghav_engineering: Rollout plan: start 09:15 PT with 5% canary for 10m, 30% for 15m, then 100% by 10:00 PT if no regressions. Watch p95 and error rate; auto-rollback if error rate >0.5% or p95 regress >25%. No infra holds.

claire_docs: Docs are published to staging: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-6-staging. Final will flip to /v2-6 on publish. Added migration snippet and a short "Known compatibility" note. Copyable snippet for email: ```{"serving":{"quantize":"opt-in","profile":"compact-3"}}```

paul_legal: Quick check on marketing claims: if you use "up to X%" please ensure benchmark source is linked and wording includes the workload qualifier. Can we avoid absolute phrasing like "reduces cost" without the qualifier? Provide the internal bench link and we'll sign off.

ana_marketing: We'll use: "Reduce token cost by up to 32% on common chat workloads" and include the bench link. Is that OK? Also need a short headline — option A: "v2.6: faster inference, lower token cost" option B: "Cut chat inference cost up to 32% with v2.6". Thoughts?

raghav_engineering: Bench link: https://tiny.redwood.com/v2-6-bench-report. The 32% is peak from our internal trace; median is 26%. Good to add the qualifier "depending on workload." No objection to copy with that qualifier.

paul_legal: Works if the email includes the bench link and the phrase "depending on workload". Also add: "Results from internal benchmark; your mileage may vary." That's enough for sign-off.

jen_salesops: Salesops: form will add tag "v2_6_launch" and route to queue "launch_inbound". I'll smoke test after send and report back here.

ci-bot: Release pipeline queued by raghav_engineering at 1923456820. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/56011

raghav_engineering: Canary 5% stable at 09:25 PT; moving to 30% at 09:35 PT. No errors or regression spikes.

ci-bot: Full rollout completed at 1923456940. Status: success. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/56011/console

ana_marketing: LIVE  announcement sent at 10:00 PT. Email includes headline: "Cut chat inference cost up to 32% with v2.6", bench link, docs link (will flip to /v2-6), migration snippet, hero chart, and webinar CTA (Tue 9am PT). Salesops: ping when tagging confirmed. Thanks team! :tada: 

jen_salesops: Confirmed: post-send tag smoke test passed. Leads are tagged "v2_6_launch" and routed to "launch_inbound". No issues.

paul_legal: Confirmed the required bench link and qualifier are present in the email copy. Signed off.

raghav_engineering: Monitoring looks good post-rollout. No anomalies.

ana_marketing: Great  closing notes: archive perf PNG and CSV in the marketing drive, I'll drop links in the release notes. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
